video.title: AI欧腐《致命缪斯：被黑帮教父占有/Fatal Muse:Claimed by the Mafia Boss》
video.desc:
Cesare Scalici is a gifted painter. His own father drugs him and sells him to the head of the Grimaldi family. Cesare accidentally stumbles into Mafia boss Elio Montanari's room and shares a passionate night. This twist of fate ultimately brings them together.
Cesare Scalici 是一位天赋出众的画家。亲生父亲给他下了药，把他卖给了 Grimaldi 家族的家主。昏沉之中，Cesare 误闯进了黑帮教父 Elio Montanari 的房间，与他共度了激情的一夜。这场阴差阳错，最终将两人的命运绑在了一起。
